title: The Scrap Heap
text: A hill of broken arms and armor rises from the ground: rusted swords, split shields, helms with the heads still in them. A tinker squats on top, grinning. By the rules of the heap, he says, the one carrying least may take the most.

options.label: The one with the most room in their pack climbs the heap, as the rules allow.

outcomes.text: They come down loaded, careful not to look at the helms.

options.label: The most armored climbs it anyway; rules are for tinkers.

outcomes.text: The heap slides, taking their legs with it.
Buried deep, they find the tinker's own good hammer.

options.label: Trade with the tinker for parts and leave the heap to him.

outcomes.text: Fair weight for fair coin. He grins the whole time.
